name: The Worcester Fair
summary: The Worcester Fair is a well-established community shopping center on Greenwood Street in Worcester, Massachusetts, offering extended hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily. With a strong 4.2-star rating from over 2,100 reviews, it serves as a convenient retail hub for Central Massachusetts residents.
demographics: The Worcester Fair attracts a diverse middle-income demographic primarily from Worcester and surrounding Central Massachusetts communities. The trade area serves families and working professionals with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, representing a mix of homeowners and renters typical of Worcester's urban and suburban neighborhoods. Shoppers tend to be value-conscious consumers seeking convenient access to everyday goods and services, with a strong representation of millennials and Gen X families balancing work and household responsibilities.
description: The Worcester Fair stands as a vibrant community shopping destination in the heart of Worcester, Massachusetts, serving the diverse needs of Central Massachusetts residents. With its convenient location on Greenwood Street, this shopping center has established itself as a reliable hub for everyday shopping and services in the Worcester area. Operating from early morning at 6:00 AM until late evening at 11:00 PM, The Worcester Fair accommodates the busy schedules of working families and professionals who need flexible shopping hours. The center has earned a solid reputation among local shoppers, reflected in its 4.2-star rating from over 2,100 customer reviews, demonstrating consistent satisfaction with the shopping experience. As a community-focused retail destination, The Worcester Fair continues to serve as an accessible and practical choice for Worcester residents seeking quality retail options close to home.
